decisions.reason: The charge-interface impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the external connector, CHGLED circuit, resistor values, and D1/R6 population states.
J_LED_CHG is a dedicated charge-LED connector, not either of the defined interboard power or signal connectors, so their references, types, and pin semantics remain unchanged.
Adding J_LED_CHG does not change the existing general requirement for bottom-side connector pin markings or resolve the battery-connector labeling ambiguity.
The charge-LED connector and R6/D1 population changes do not alter the J_BAT NTC interface or its AXP2101 thermal-protection function.
The source specifies the new connector's electrical identity and type but does not specify placement, orientation, access, or mounting-hole clearance changes.
R6 is identified as part of the CHGLED circuit, not an I2C pull-up or series resistor, so the I2C conditioning state remains unchanged.
The source changes charge-LED components and does not affect the portability or resolution of the L1 inductor footprint.
The CHGLED circuit and R6/D1 population decision does not change the AXP2101 or DW01A battery-protection behavior.
Adding a connector and changing component values on the existing power board does not add, remove, or repartition any project board.
The charge-LED circuit modification does not change the power board's four-layer stack.
The source does not entail any change to board dimensions, orientation, USB-C placement, mounting holes, or aspect ratio.
The J_LED_CHG and R6/D1 changes concern charge indication and do not alter the switchable 5V rail, its GPIO control, or its interboard routes.
